references.text: The command to love the Lord with all your heart and all your soul is fundamental to the covenant relationship with God
Moses exhorts Israel to keep the statutes and laws that the Lord has commanded them
Moses calls Israel together to hear the statutes and laws they are to learn and keep
Reminder to keep the commandments, statutes, and laws that the Lord commands
The requirement to serve the Lord with all your heart and all your soul, and to keep his commandments and statutes
The command to love the Lord and always keep his statutes, laws, commandments, and decrees
Similar language about loving the Lord, walking in his ways, and keeping his commandments and statutes
Promise of blessing if Israel keeps the Lord's statutes and commandments
Prophecy that God will give his Spirit so that the people keep his statutes and laws
Jesus quotes the command to love the Lord with all your heart and all your soul
